description: Observed clouds for net9010. Temperatures, distances and beams are ASSUMPTIONS used to convert the maps to the training units (velocities / c_s) and to set the resolution channel; edit them here, nothing is hard-coded in predict_observations_net9010.py.

notes.T_K: 10 K for the dark clouds and 20 K for Orion are placeholders; c_s scales as sqrt(T), so the predicted Ms scales as 1/sqrt(T) through the velocity channels
notes.beam_arcsec: FCRAO 13CO beam ~46 arcsec on 23 arcsec pixels; NRO 45m 13CO ~22 arcsec (check); CfA 8.4 arcmin
notes.taurus: 12CO, 0.65 km/s channels and a ~39 pc tile: far outside the training data, reported only as a sanity check
notes.orion: 0.5 km/s channels: narrow lines are unresolved in velocity
notes.Ms_literature: fill from linewidth-based estimates (use observed linewidths, not derived dissipation times)
